assessments.claim: Tenant must vacate after at most eight months
assessments.reason: The draft limits exemption from ordinary tenant protection and expressly allows continuation/new ordinary indefinite tenancy. However the author places the statement immediately within a conditional forecast of how providers will adapt their business. It can refer to provider behaviour rather than compulsory statutory eviction. The literal legal reading conflicts with the draft, but this benign contextual reading prevents a proved error. No forecast falsity established.

assessments.claim: Only2022 and2023 in past25years would the proposed index cap have applied
assessments.reason: Destatis annual overall CPI change in2021 is3.1%, already exceeding3%. The author omits at least this year. The bill measures an actual one-year interval rather than calendar-year average; this means three calendar years are not a complete corrected count of individual index-rent adjustments. Still the broad only-two-years assertion is contradicted on its own ordinary calendar-year reading. The0.1-point excess implies only0.05-point cap reduction for that annual example, so this auxiliary historical-support error is minor and does not refute the general claim that high-inflation periods were infrequent.
